project.idea_text: I want an online food delivery app

summary: An online food delivery platform that connects customers with local restaurants, allowing users to browse menus, place orders, make digital payments, and track their deliveries in real time.
assumptions: The initial launch will focus on a web-based portal and mobile-responsive interface.
Third-party payment gateways will handle credit card and digital wallet transactions.
Delivery logistics will be managed by independent courier partners using a dedicated driver interface.
Restaurant partners will manage their own menu availability and order acceptance via a partner dashboard.

requirements.text: Customers can register, log in, and manage their profile details including saved delivery addresses.
Customers can search for restaurants by name, cuisine type, or dish.
Customers can view restaurant menus, item descriptions, prices, and customization options.
Customers can add items to a shopping cart and place an order using electronic payment methods.
Customers can view the real-time status and live map tracking of their active food delivery.
Restaurants can accept or reject incoming orders and update preparation status through an order management view.
Couriers can accept available delivery tasks and update delivery status as orders progress.
Customers can leave ratings and text reviews for completed restaurant orders.
The system shall display menu pages within 2 seconds of a customer request under normal load conditions.
All user payment transactions must be encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 protocol.
The food ordering system shall maintain 99.9% uptime during peak meal hours (11:00-14:00 and 17:00-21:00).

epics.title: User Authentication and Profile Management
epics.description: Enables customers to securely create accounts, manage login credentials, and save delivery addresses.

epics.title: Restaurant Discovery and Menus
epics.description: Allows customers to search for restaurants, browse menus, and view detailed dish options efficiently.

epics.title: Cart, Ordering, and Payments
epics.description: Handles cart management, checkout processes, and secure electronic payment processing.

epics.title: Order Fulfillment and Delivery Tracking
epics.description: Provides order processing tools for restaurants, task assignment for couriers, and live tracking for users.

epics.title: Reviews and Ratings
epics.description: Enables post-delivery customer feedback for restaurants.

epics.title: Platform Performance and Security
epics.description: Ensures platform reliability, fast performance, and secure payment handling.

stories.i_want: to register and log into my account
stories.so_that: I can access personalized services and view my order history
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user on the signup page, when valid details are submitted, then an account is created.
Given a registered user, when correct credentials are entered, then login succeeds within 2 seconds.

stories.i_want: to save and manage multiple delivery addresses
stories.so_that: I can easily select my current location during checkout
acceptance_criteria: Given an authenticated user, when adding a new address, then it appears in the saved addresses list.
Given a user with saved addresses, when editing an address, then changes are saved correctly.

stories.i_want: to search for restaurants by name, cuisine, or dish
stories.so_that: I can quickly find the exact food I am craving
acceptance_criteria: Given a search query, when executed, matching restaurants and dishes are listed.
Given filter parameters, when applied, results are narrowed down accurately.

stories.i_want: to view restaurant menus and customize dish options
stories.so_that: I can tailor my meal to my dietary preferences
acceptance_criteria: Given a restaurant page, when opened, the full menu with prices is displayed.
Given a customizable dish, when selected, available options (e.g., spice level) are configurable.

stories.i_want: to add items to a cart and checkout using digital payments
stories.so_that: I can place my food order conveniently
acceptance_criteria: Given items in the cart, when checking out, the total price including fees is calculated.
Given valid payment details, when submitted, the transaction processes successfully.

stories.i_want: to view, accept, or reject incoming orders
stories.so_that: I can manage kitchen preparation effectively
acceptance_criteria: Given a new incoming order, when the restaurant accepts it, the status updates to preparing.
Given a new incoming order, when rejected, the customer is notified immediately.

stories.i_want: to accept delivery tasks and update order progress
stories.so_that: I can deliver food efficiently to customers
acceptance_criteria: Given an available delivery task, when accepted by a courier, it is assigned exclusively to them.
Given an in-transit order, when marked delivered by the courier, the order updates to completed.

stories.i_want: to track my active food delivery on a live map
stories.so_that: I know exactly when my food will arrive
acceptance_criteria: Given an active order in transit, when opening tracking, the courier's real-time location is displayed on a map.
Given a status change in delivery, when updated by courier, the change reflects on the user UI.

stories.i_want: to rate and review my completed food order
stories.so_that: I can share my experience with other users and the restaurant
acceptance_criteria: Given a completed order, when submitting a 1-5 star rating and text review, it saves successfully.
Given a submitted review, when viewing the restaurant page, the overall average rating reflects the feedback.

stories.i_want: all payment data encrypted with TLS 1.3
stories.so_that: user sensitive financial data remains completely safe
acceptance_criteria: Given any payment API endpoint, when inspected, all connections enforce TLS 1.3 encryption.
Given non-TLS 1.3 payment connection attempts, when initiated, they are rejected by the system.

stories.i_want: menu pages to load in under 2 seconds and high system uptime during peak hours
stories.so_that: customers experience fast load times and reliable service when ordering
acceptance_criteria: Given normal load, when a menu page is requested, it loads in under 2 seconds.
Given peak hours (11-14 and 17-21), when system uptime is measured, it remains at or above 99.9%.

tasks.title: Design authentication database schema and user tables
tasks.description: Create database schema and migration scripts for user accounts, credentials, and authentication sessions.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Standard database schema design for user tables and authentication entity relationships.

tasks.title: Implement registration and login REST endpoints
tasks.description: Develop backend endpoints for user signup and authentication using secure password hashing and JWT issuance. Ensure sub-2-second response time.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Backend logic and endpoints for password hashing, registration, and login token generation.

tasks.title: Build login and registration UI components
tasks.description: Develop signup and login forms with client-side validation, error handling, and session state management.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Standard frontend form design with validation for login and registration flows.

tasks.title: Write automated tests for authentication flow
tasks.description: Create integration and unit tests covering successful and failed login/signup scenarios, validating response times.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Writing automated unit and integration tests for auth controllers and tokens.

tasks.title: Create address management database tables
tasks.description: Design and execute database migrations for storing multiple user delivery addresses linked to the user account.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Simple schema definition for address entities with user relationships.

tasks.title: Implement address CRUD API endpoints
tasks.description: Develop backend endpoints allowing authenticated users to create, read, update, and delete delivery addresses.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Standard CRUD API endpoints for managing user address records.

tasks.title: Build address management interface
tasks.description: Develop UI screens to list saved addresses, add new delivery locations, and edit existing address details.
tasks.estimate_rationale: UI components for displaying, adding, editing, and deleting saved addresses.

tasks.title: Implement search and filtering API endpoint for restaurants and dishes
tasks.description: Create a backend endpoint that accepts search query strings and filter parameters (cuisine, rating, dish type) and queries the database for matching results.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Backend search and filtering queries involving complex indexing across multiple entities.

tasks.title: Build UI search bar and filter controls for restaurant discovery
tasks.description: Design and implement responsive search bar and filter UI components allowing users to search by name, cuisine, or dish with real-time result updates.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Frontend search input with filtering controls and state management.

tasks.title: Write unit and integration tests for search filter logic
tasks.description: Add backend integration tests verifying search query accuracy, fuzzy matching, and filter parameter combinations for restaurant discovery.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Targeted unit and integration tests for search query combinations and edge cases.

tasks.title: Build menu retrieval and dish customization endpoints
tasks.description: Develop REST APIs to fetch full restaurant menus with prices and retrieve customizable options (e.g., spice levels, add-ons) for specific dishes.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Backend endpoints to retrieve nested menu items and handle customization options.

tasks.title: Develop restaurant menu display and dish options modal UI
tasks.description: Create the front-end page for displaying structured menus with prices and interactive modal popups for selecting dish options and dietary preferences.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Interactive UI display for restaurant menus and dish customization modal options.

tasks.title: Automate end-to-end menu navigation and customization testing
tasks.description: Implement E2E test cases covering user navigation to restaurant pages, rendering full menus, and selecting dish customization options.
tasks.estimate_rationale: End-to-end automation scripts for testing menu navigation and modal selections.

tasks.title: Implement cart management and total price calculation API
tasks.description: Create backend endpoints for adding items to cart and calculating total price including delivery fees and taxes as specified in acceptance criteria.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Cart session management combined with total price dynamic calculation logic.

tasks.title: Integrate Stripe payment gateway for checkout processing
tasks.description: Integrate third-party payment processor to securely submit and process customer transactions during checkout.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Complex third-party payment integration with webhook handling and secure processing.

tasks.title: Build frontend cart and checkout payment UI
tasks.description: Develop user interface for customers to view cart items, fee breakdowns, enter payment details, and complete order checkout.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Multi-step checkout interface handling cart validation and payment SDK integration.

tasks.title: Create end-to-end automated tests for cart checkout flow
tasks.description: Write integration and E2E tests validating cart calculation accuracy and successful payment transaction flows.
tasks.estimate_rationale: End-to-end test suite for validating full cart update and checkout sequence.

tasks.title: Implement order acceptance and rejection backend endpoints
tasks.description: Create API endpoints for restaurant staff to update order status to preparing or rejected. Trigger immediate customer notifications on rejection.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Order status update API endpoints with state machine constraints.

tasks.title: Build restaurant order management dashboard UI
tasks.description: Develop incoming order management UI displaying real-time order requests with clear Accept and Reject action buttons.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Real-time or responsive dashboard UI for restaurant staff to process orders.

tasks.title: Write unit and integration tests for order decision flows
tasks.description: Test order status transitions from pending to preparing or rejected, ensuring notification events fire correctly on rejection.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Integration tests validating state transitions for order acceptance or rejection.

tasks.title: Implement courier task assignment and status tracking API
tasks.description: Create atomic task acceptance mechanism to prevent double assignment and allow status updates to delivered and completed.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Task assignment engine and state tracking API for active couriers.

tasks.title: Develop courier mobile app delivery workflow interface
tasks.description: Build UI screens for couriers to view available tasks, accept exclusive assignments, and mark orders as delivered.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Mobile delivery UI tailored for courier task acceptance and progress updates.

tasks.title: Test courier task concurrency and state transitions
tasks.description: Verify concurrent task acceptance logic and validate end-to-end status flow from accepted to completed.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Testing concurrent driver assignments and state transition edge cases.

tasks.title: Implement WebSocket service for live GPS tracking stream
tasks.description: Build WebSocket server to ingest courier GPS location updates and publish real-time location and status changes to tracking subscribers.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Complex WebSocket architecture for processing real-time concurrent GPS coordinate streams.

tasks.title: Build live interactive map tracking component
tasks.description: Integrate interactive map component in customer app displaying real-time courier pin updates and status notifications.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Interactive map interface displaying real-time location updates from WebSockets.

tasks.title: Integrate third-party mapping SDK
tasks.description: Configure map provider SDK (e.g. Google Maps or Mapbox) with real-time marker movement and route render logic.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Setup and configuration of external mapping SDK provider.

tasks.title: Create database schema for order ratings and reviews
tasks.description: Design and execute migration for the reviews table storing order_id, user_id, restaurant_id, star rating (1-5), and review text.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Simple database table schema for storing ratings and textual reviews.

tasks.title: Implement order review submission and aggregation API
tasks.description: Build POST /orders/{id}/reviews endpoint validating completed status and 1-5 rating. Recalculate and update restaurant average rating upon successful save.
tasks.estimate_rationale: API endpoints for submitting feedback and calculating aggregate ratings.

tasks.title: Build rating and review submission form component
tasks.description: Create UI for completed orders allowing customers to select a 1-5 star rating, enter a text review, and submit feedback with error handling.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Frontend input component for star ratings and review feedback.

tasks.title: Add automated tests for review submission and average calculation
tasks.description: Write integration tests validating review submission rules, preventing duplicate reviews per order, and confirming restaurant average updates accurately.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Unit tests verifying review submission endpoints and average math calculations.

tasks.title: Configure server ingress rules to enforce TLS 1.3 for payment endpoints
tasks.description: Update web server/ingress configuration to accept only TLS 1.3 protocol versions and modern cipher suites for all payment-related routes, explicitly rejecting TLS 1.2 and lower.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Configuration update to ingress server rules enforcing TLS version.

tasks.title: Implement automated security tests for TLS enforcement
tasks.description: Create integration tests that attempt connections to payment endpoints using legacy TLS versions and assert that the connections are actively rejected.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Automated security test scripts checking TLS version enforcement.

tasks.title: Implement Redis caching layer for restaurant menu data
tasks.description: Cache menu API responses in Redis with proper cache invalidation on menu updates to ensure endpoint response times remain well under 2 seconds.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Setting up Redis cache layer and implementing invalidation strategies for menus.

tasks.title: Optimize frontend menu rendering and asset delivery
tasks.description: Implement code splitting, lazy loading of menu images, and payload optimization on menu pages to achieve sub-2-second page load times.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Frontend optimization focusing on asset compression and component render performance.

tasks.title: Set up auto-scaling rules and uptime monitoring for peak hours
tasks.description: Configure infrastructure auto-scaling groups based on CPU/memory usage and establish synthetic uptime monitoring alerts targeting 99.9% uptime during peak hours.
tasks.estimate_rationale: DevOps configuration for cluster autoscaling policies and uptime metrics.

signals.message: CPM duration is 116 h (19.5 working days); 6 of 35 tasks (17%) are critical.
T-011 "Build menu retrieval and dish customization endpoints" has 22 downstream tasks and 0 h slack (CPM).
T-014 "Implement cart management and total price calculation API" has 16 downstream tasks and 0 h slack (CPM).
T-018 "Implement order acceptance and rejection backend endpoints" has 10 downstream tasks and 0 h slack (CPM).
Sprint 1 is loaded to 100% (40 of 40 points).
Sprint 2 is loaded to 98% (39 of 40 points).
Sprint 3 is loaded to 100% (40 of 40 points).
Capacity-feasible plan is 180 h (3 sprints) against a CPM minimum of 116 h: ratio 1.55x.
Layer backend holds 96 of 116 critical-path hours (83%).

risks.title: High-fanout critical backend tasks present major bottleneck
risks.description: Tasks T-011, T-014, and T-018 on the critical path have 0 h slack (CPM) and direct high downstream dependencies (22, 16, and 10 downstream tasks respectively). Any delay in these core endpoints will instantly block broad dependent work across the project.
risks.mitigation: Prioritize and allocate senior backend engineering resources to T-011, T-014, and T-018 to ensure on-time delivery and unblock downstream teams.

risks.title: Severe sprint capacity saturation across all sprints
risks.description: Sprint 1 and Sprint 3 are fully saturated at 100% capacity load (40 of 40 points each), while Sprint 2 is loaded at 98% (39 of 40 points). There is zero buffer to accommodate unexpected task complexity or scope expansion across the entire release cycle.
risks.mitigation: Re-balance story points across sprints or de-scope non-critical tasks from Sprints 1, 2, and 3 to build a sustainable capacity buffer.

risks.title: Backend layer concentration on the critical path
risks.description: The backend layer accounts for 96 out of 116 critical-path hours (83%), while CPM duration is 116 h across 6 critical tasks out of 35 total tasks (17%). Backend delivery delays directly determine the minimum project finish time.
risks.mitigation: Cross-train frontend or full-stack developers to assist with critical backend endpoints and reduce critical-path backend dependency.

risks.title: Significant schedule expansion from resource capacity constraints
risks.description: The capacity-feasible plan requires 180 h (3 sprints) compared to the theoretical CPM minimum of 116 h, resulting in a 1.55x duration expansion ratio due to resource capacity limitations.
risks.mitigation: Evaluate options to increase short-term team capacity or adjust project milestones to align expectations with the realistic 180 h timeline.
